title: SKIP_STEP / terminal-state bypass: refund/request accepted again after the order already shows 'no further actions available'
unsupported_reason: This isolates whether the terminal state itself (UIR-002: no actions available after completion) can be reopened by a bare refund/request call, without chaining a second completion (that fuller double-payout chain is covered by plan 04). A lone re-request does not change order.totalReturned, so sum_lte cannot express whether reopening a terminal order was wrongly accepted; it requires reviewing refund.status/requestedAt and order.history for a new 'refund_requested' event after a 'refund_completed' event.
